rules.title: A toothed part has a standard tooth profile
rules.statement: A toothed part carries the standard profile from a cited source plus a stated nozzle allowance, proved on a short test arc before a large part. A new tooth type gets its check case before it is modelled. The check of the profile stays a project script.
rules.why: Three pulleys were printed with a concept groove, one circle per tooth: the belt could not seat and all three were printed again.

attest.question: Toothed part: which check of the tooth profile was run on this geometry, and what did it say?
labels: the project profile check ran on this geometry: pass

rules.note: Deferred: the gate cannot run a project-owned check yet. Until then process.concept_geometry asks.

rules.title: A toothed part prints on a fine nozzle, in the right project
rules.statement: A feature narrower than one line cannot print true. A toothed part prints on a nozzle of {teeth.nozzle_max} or finer. One slicer project holds one nozzle: a part that needs another nozzle never sits in the wrong project.
rules.why: A large pulley was printed a second time on a 0.6 nozzle from the corrected mesh: the belt still did not seat.
rules.note: Kept by walls.min_material and walls.one_line, which judge at the line width of the target, and by project.target_differs.

rules.title: The nozzle allowance of a profile is a parameter
rules.statement: The nozzle allowance of a tooth profile is a parameter: {teeth.allowance_width} on the groove width and {teeth.allowance_depth} on its depth are starting values for a 0.6 nozzle. The land at the tooth tip stays at least {teeth.tip_land_min}.
rules.why: A profile that was right in the model could not be printed with the nozzle of its project.

rules.title: A belt drive is laid out round stocked belts and the measured pulley
rules.statement: A belt drive uses closed belts of stocked lengths. Tooth counts are chosen to hit the centre distance and to absorb later changes. Small pulleys on motor shafts are bought. A closed belt needs an adjustable centre distance with a defined method. The belt plane is set by the measured pulley; the motor mount adapts to it.
rules.why: A printed part had its motor face in the wrong plane for the real pulley and was printed again.
